# Indiana Jones and the Search for a New Team: The Dynasty Fantasy Football Impact of Daniel Jones’ release
### [Daniel Jones](https://dynastyleaguefootball.com/player/9992205/Daniel_Jones), QB FA
A week ago, the Colts refused to trade Jones at the deadline, thinking he could still turn it around and be their quarterback of the future. Three days ago, the Colts were indicating any new regime (Shane Steichen seems like he’s just coaching out the string) would be able to work with Jones and Jonathan Taylor to re-work the team. Last night, Jones was awful in a loss to the Texans. Today, he’s looking for a new job.
When and if Jones signs somewhere, there are a number of quarterbacks who could be affected, be it [Jacoby Brissett](https://dynastyleaguefootball.com/player/18018/Jacoby_Brissett), [Tommy DeVito](https://dynastyleaguefootball.com/player/9994451/Tommy_DeVito), [Joe Milton](https://dynastyleaguefootball.com/player/9993165/Joe_Milton), [Michael Penix](https://dynastyleaguefootball.com/player/9993521/Michael_Penix), or [Kyler Murray](https://dynastyleaguefootball.com/player/9992531/Kyler_Murray).
